title: Cycle–clique Ramsey numbers

result.label: Cycle–clique Ramsey numbers
result.statement: Proves the Erdős–Faudree–Rousseau–Schelp conjecture: R(Cm,Kn)=(m-1)(n-1)+1 for every m n 3, except R(C3,K3)=6. This is the exact threshold forcing a red m -cycle or a blue n -clique in every red–blue coloring of a complete graph.
